newsitem.title: CANADA: Baton, CHUM, Electrohome in deal.
newsitem.headline: Baton, CHUM, Electrohome in deal.

text.p: Baton Broadcasting Inc, Electrohome Ltd and CHUM Ltd said on Tuesday they would exchange certain local television assets in Ontario and the Maritime provinces.
Under the deal, Baton would acquire CHUM's 14.3 percent share in CTV Television Network Ltd.
When this transaction and Baton's merger with Electrohome are complete, Baton will own 57 percent of CTV.
The asset swap agreement is subject to Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission (CRTC) approval.

Under the deal, Baton would trade duplicated coverage in Ontario to give it greater reach in the Maritimes. Baton/Electrohome television stations CFPL-TV London, CKNX-TV Wingham and CHWI-TV Windsor and Baton's CHRO-TV Pembroke/Ottawa would be swapped for CHUM's CTV affiliated stations in the Maritimes.

These stations, collectively known as ATV, would include CJCH-TV Halifax, CJCB-TVF Sydney, CKCW-TV Moncton/Charlottetown, CKLT-TV St John/Fredericton and the assets of the Atlantic Satellite Network, an independent satellite-to-cable programming service.
